description: T01 - Oak tree - Fell. Remove the existing approximately 6m high young oak tree (sapling), as it is positioned too close to the property boundary and adjacent walkway, restricting its ability to grow and mature appropriately.A replacement oak tree will be planted further back within the front garden, in a more suitable position to allow sufficient space for healthy growth and future maturity

LGW Extent of IFP (Instrument Flight Procedures Safeguarded Area): Please consult London Gatwick on the following:All other applications connected with an aviation use, for example:Development at an existing aerodrome. Creation of a new aerodrome. The use of a site for the purpose of flight or as a drop zone for parachuting. Note: For further information see citcular 01/2003 (ODPM, DfT).
